title: Crisp French Corn Fritters
description: A French-inspired corn fritter recipe with a crunchy exterior and a soft interior, perfect for a snack or side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, egg, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the oil, making sure not to overcrowd the skillet.
Fry the fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
